newsitem.title: UK: Varity Corp Q2 sales up five percent.
newsitem.headline: Varity Corp Q2 sales up five percent.

text.p: LucasVarity Plc said Varity Corp's sales in the second quarter rose by five percent to $603 million from $572 million. Operating income increased to $52 million from $51 million.
Automotive sales in the second quarter rose to $358 million from $313 million and operating income increased to $30 million from $28 million.
Sales at VarityPerkins fell to $245 million from $259 million reflecting softness in certain European diesel engine sectors and weaker sterling versus the dollar.

During its second quarter Varity Corp completed the previously announced sale of its 46.3 percent interest in Hayes Wheels and posted an after-tax gain of $101 million as a result of the sale. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
